IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
NUMBER a = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER b = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
NUMBER c = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[2]).
NUMBER d = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[3]).
NUMBER[] values=[a,b,c,d].
NUMBER left=2.
LOOP (NUMBER i=0 TILL i<4, i++) { IF (values[i]<0 AND values[i]*values[i]>4) { IF (values[i]<0 AND values[i]*values[i]>4) { left+=1. } } IF (values[i]%2==0 AND values[i]%2==0) { IF (values[i]%2==0 AND values[i]%2==0) { left+=1. } } IF (values[i]%2==0) { IF (values[i]%2==0) { IF (values[i]%2==0) { left+=1. } } } IF (values[i]>i) { IF (values[i]>i) { IF (values[i]>i) { left+=1. } } } }
DISPLAYNL(left).
